lessons_learned: Conduct a full data quality audit before committing to an ETL design. In 2021, undiscovered null mandatory fields in 12,000 payroll records caused 3 failed migration rehearsals and added 8 weeks to the programme.
Parallel run period must be at least 6 weeks for financial systems. A 3-week parallel run in 2021 was insufficient to catch monthly payroll cycle edge cases.
Data remediation is a business process exercise, not just a technical one. Finance sign-off on default-value mapping rules is mandatory before any automated remediation is applied.
Mandate data reconciliation reports as a programme deliverable, not an afterthought. Automated reconciliation between source and target counts caught 340 discrepancies pre-cutover.
Define a clear cutover go / no-go checklist with measurable criteria at least 8 weeks before planned cutover date.

historical_risks.title: Payroll Data Integrity Failure During Migration
historical_risks.mitigation: Full data audit completed over 6 weeks. All null fields mapped to validated defaults approved by HR and Finance. Three migration rehearsals conducted before live cutover.
historical_risks.outcome: Zero data loss on go-live. Two minor discrepancies (14 records) caught by reconciliation framework and resolved within 48 hours of cutover.

historical_risks.title: Year-End Payroll Processing Disruption
historical_risks.mitigation: Parallel run extended from 3 to 8 weeks, spanning a full month-end payroll cycle. Rollback procedure tested and rehearsed.
historical_risks.outcome: December payroll processed successfully on new system. Legacy system remained available as fallback for 30 days post-cutover.

historical_risks.title: Supplier (ETL Tool Vendor) Feature Gap
historical_risks.mitigation: Evaluated three ETL vendors before selection. Proof-of-concept conducted against production-like data volumes.
historical_risks.outcome: Selected vendor delivered all contracted features. One performance issue identified in POC and resolved before project start.

successful_mitigations: 8-week parallel run caught all critical monthly payroll cycle edge cases before decommissioning legacy system.
Data audit framework (now reused across all migration projects) prevented data loss by identifying issues 12 weeks before planned cutover.
Finance-approved default-value mapping ruleset eliminated all blocking null-field issues within 4 weeks of audit completion.
Automated reconciliation reports ran nightly during parallel run, giving the team confidence to proceed with cutover.

project_name: Finance Consolidation ERP Migration (Oracle to SAP, 2019)
lessons_learned: Executive sponsorship must be visible and active, not ceremonial. In 2019, passive sponsorship led to business units deprioritising UAT participation, causing a 6-week UAT delay.
Cutover weekend planning must begin at least 16 weeks before go-live. The 2019 programme started cutover planning 8 weeks out and experienced a 22-hour overrun on cutover weekend.
Chart of accounts rationalisation must be completed and signed off before ETL design begins. Retroactive changes to CoA mappings invalidated 40% of ETL transformations in 2019.
SAP ABAP performance issues under production load are best discovered during load-tested QA cycles, not UAT. Three critical performance issues found during UAT in 2019 caused a 4-week delay.
Define hypercare staffing levels before go-live. The 2019 programme underestimated Day-1 support demand by 60%.

historical_risks.title: Chart of Accounts Mapping Instability
historical_risks.mitigation: CoA freeze mandated 20 weeks before ETL development start. Finance sign-off obtained on all 2,400 account mappings before development commenced.
historical_risks.outcome: Zero CoA mapping changes after freeze date. ETL development completed on schedule.

historical_risks.title: Business Unit UAT Non-Participation
historical_risks.mitigation: CEO mandate issued for UAT participation. UAT co-ordinator appointed in each business unit. UAT readiness gates introduced at Programme Board.
historical_risks.outcome: Full business unit participation achieved. UAT completed 2 days ahead of schedule.

successful_mitigations: CoA freeze policy prevented retroactive mapping changes that derailed the 2019 programme.
CEO mandate for UAT participation ensured 100% business unit engagement.
16-week cutover planning horizon allowed a dry-run rehearsal 4 weeks before go-live, reducing cutover weekend from 22 hours (2019 actual) to 14 hours.
